subject: english
title: Unit 6 Project
subtitle: Make posters to help sea animals — research, poster, cards, clean-up, photos.

content: Name all five project steps in order.
Research real ways to help sea animals and choose three, with a reason for each.
Design a poster with a big title, one fact and one ask.
language: Write the poster ask with must or can't (Grammar 1).
Write an invitation that answers what, where and when.
Say why a poster is not an essay — five seconds, one ask.

notes: The project title and all five steps are verbatim from Student Book pp. 106-107. The six research actions on slide 4 are built from Unit 6 vocabulary (garbage, plastic, overfishing, pop-top, oil spill) and from the Reading; the model poster and card on slides 5 and 7 are composed from unit content, not quoted from the book. Steps 1-4 happen in this lesson and in Leo's app; step 5 happens on the day of the clean-up.
